description: This PHP class 'ReportGroup' is an entity definition used with Doctrine ORM. It represents a report group within the OrangeHRM system, including properties such as id, name, and coreSql, with corresponding getter and setter methods. It is annotated for ORM mapping to the database table 'ohrm_report_group'.

classes.name: ReportGroup
classes.description: Entity representing a report group with properties for id, name, and coreSql, mapped to table 'ohrm_report_group' in the database.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the report group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the report group.

methods.name: getCoreSql
methods.description: Returns the core SQL string associated with the report group.

methods.name: setCoreSql
methods.description: Sets the core SQL string for the report group.
